verdict.rationale: Anrok documents several pieces of this story. Its dashboard shows sales data by jurisdiction. Transactions are associated with tax returns. An API endpoint fetches filings, and Anrok handles filing and payments. Nothing in the pack documents a real-time accrued-liability view comparing collected with owed by jurisdiction, or exports formatted for accountants or GL systems. Missing for 10: accrued liability by jurisdiction at any moment, collected-versus-owed reconciliation, accountant/GL-consumable exports, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see accrued liability by jurisdiction at any moment — collected versus owed, filing-ready detail, and exports my accountant and GL can consume
